xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5472: docs: fix published pages that contradict the product (state branch, Cloister routing, Inspect, phone apps, introduction)

plan.title: docs: fix published pages that contradict the product (state branch, Cloister routing, Inspect, phone apps, introduction)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Eleven doc files only. lintProjectedSurface counts each root-level doc path (README.md, concepts.mdx, docs.json) and each docs folder (configuration, features, reference) as its own subsystem; the real surface is one docs site plus the README.

narratives.Problem: Eight published docs pages and README.md describe removed or unreleased features: the overdeck-state branch, Cloister model routing and five specialists including an inspect agent and a merge agent, Approve & Merge, beads, mid-conversation model swaps, checkpoint rollback, Cursor/Gemini/Antigravity skill sync, Shadow Engineering, public phone apps, Mission Control as the landing view, and a God View that is really experimental. New users read these pages first.
narratives.Proposal: Fix each claim in place against verified code (PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-5472.md, Background table): delete configuration/state-branch.mdx with a redirect to /reference/state-model and give that page a .pan/ section; rewrite features/cloister.mdx and features/specialists.mdx from the PRD outlines; make targeted edits to concepts.mdx, configuration/phone.mdx, reference/god-view.mdx, features/mission-control.mdx and README.md (three serialized README items); then run mint validate, mint broken-links and lint:docs and paste the results in the PR body. Every touched page loses its en and em dashes.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Editing introduction.mdx (moved to #5505, already merged).
- Editing configuration/setup-wizard.mdx or configuration/meta-repos.mdx (#5482 G18 owns delete-or-rewrite).
- A full line-by-line audit of the touched pages (#5499, #5502, #5503, #5504 run after this PR).
- Changing features/mission-control.mdx beyond the intro, Mission Control wording, Shadow Engineering and dashes (#5474, #5502).
- Renaming features/mission-control.mdx or removing its "All projects and side-by-side conversations" heading.
- Any code change: the PlanDialog Shadow Engineering checkbox, the unrendered BadgeBar.tsx, the stuck_escalation model literals, the phone dialog store buttons, or the stale Experimental switch description.
- Deleting image files, deleting the overdeck-state branch, or telling readers to delete it.
- Writing new pages such as features/issue-pipeline.mdx (#5468) or features/dashboard-views.mdx (#5474).
- Reformatting or reordering docs.json beyond the one nav line and one redirect.
- A changelog.d entry (docs-only change).

autoDecisions.summary: Delete configuration/state-branch.mdx and add a docs.json redirect to /reference/state-model.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for removal from navigation plus a redirect; deleting the file follows the /configuration/beads precedent and keeps the old page from rendering at its URL.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a .pan/ layout section and a retired-branch section to reference/state-model.mdx and remove its record-plane claims.
autoDecisions.rationale: The redirect target itself cited a nonexistent lint-state-writes.sh and a deleted per-issue record, and order-books.mdx links there for where order books live.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave setup-wizard.mdx and meta-repos.mdx to #5482 G18.
autoDecisions.rationale: Both are unpublished and #5482 explicitly owns deleting or rewriting them; partial fixes here would be thrown away.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete Shadow Engineering from concepts.mdx and mission-control.mdx rather than redescribe it.
autoDecisions.rationale: Only a checkbox that writes a placeholder INFERENCE.md remains; no monitoring agent exists and BadgeBar.tsx is not rendered, so there is no working feature to document.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not document the stuck_escalation model handoff on the Cloister page.
autoDecisions.rationale: triggers.ts compares model ids to the literals haiku and sonnet, which current model ids never equal, so the trigger does not fire.

autoDecisions.summary: Limit mission-control.mdx edits to the intro, Mission Control wording, Shadow Engineering and dashes.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists only those claims for that page; #5474 and #5502 own the rest.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix README claims in place without changing its tagline or structure, split into three serialized items by line range.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to fix the same claims; three items keep each diff reviewable, and they share one file so they must run in order.

autoDecisions.summary: Say "more than 120 skills" instead of an exact count.
autoDecisions.rationale: sync-sources/skills holds 126 folders including _template and 4 redirects; an exact count drifts with every skill change.

autoDecisions.summary: Phone page states the TestFlight and Play internal testing status and points to the browser phone view; no join instructions.
autoDecisions.rationale: changelog v0.74.0 and apps/mobile/RELEASE.md show only operator tester groups, so inventing a join path would be another false claim.

autoDecisions.summary: Link sibling pages (issue-pipeline, dashboard-views) only if the file exists at work time.
autoDecisions.rationale: Those pages belong to unmerged sibling issues; a link to a missing page fails mint broken-links.
